title: Tenma Saki — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Hona, Shiho, why are you guys in my classroom?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You all texted me happy birthday at midnight, so I never thought you'd pull off something like this! Talk about getting caught off guard!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not every day we get to do this. Plus, something as important as this ought to be said in person.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I love you all sooo much♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa! Don't just jump at me like that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I wanted to hug you! Hona, you're next! Squeeeze!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess I have to. It is your birthday, after all. Squeeze!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Where do you think you're going, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you hug me, you're not getting your gift.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: O-Oh... But, if you give me a hug, then that will be more than worth it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?! Clearly the gift is the better option!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, excuse me. Is Saki here?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, hey guys! I can't believe even Shizuku is here!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We're all here to celebrate your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Shizuku! And you too, Minori, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We got this for you. It may be a bit bulky, but I hope you like it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! The bag is huge! Can I open it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We were wondering what to get you, but then we eventually found this online.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, it's a koala plushie! How adorable!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's called a Kuddle Koala. Um, you're supposed to wrap its arms around you like this...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! It feels like I'm getting hugged by a real koala!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Apparently, it's a bit lighter than a real koala, but about the same size.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You can use it as a hot water bottle, as a pillow for a lunchtime nap or even when you just need a hug.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, it's oh so soft and fluffy♪ I don't want this hug to end!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, looks like they found the perfect plushie for you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They really did. Just a moment ago, she was trying to get hugs from everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Oh, that reminds me, Shiho still hasn't given me a hug!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's not go through this again...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hey, hugs are important, you know. They're a way of showing love and appreciation towards those close to you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey, Shizuku! I said it's time to drop it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oooh... But if I don't get a hug from you, I'll die a sad and lonely death!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's enough now. Don't think that just because it's your birthday, you can get anything you want.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hey, do you think it's about time we told her?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If only Airi was here... What a shame.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know, riiight! Too bad she has some reaaally important errands to run...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She may not be here right now, but she did pass on a message for you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Huh? But Haruka told me she invited me to lunch...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Maybe she just hasn't arrived yet. I'll wait a little while long—)
